Your information.
A clear starting point.

The website’s project form and service finder prepare an enquiry in your browser. This version does not send it automatically or store your enquiry on a NeuroNest server.

What you choose to send

When you choose WhatsApp or email, your enquiry is passed to that service for you to review and send. Those services have their own privacy terms. NeuroNest receives the information you send and uses it to discuss your project.

Studio demonstrations

The studio demos run locally with sample data. Changes reset when the page reloads. They do not take payments, send messages or publish campaigns. Copy and download actions create a summary for you to review on your own device.

Website assets and the guide

The fonts and visual assets are served with the website. The service guide is a local guided flow, not a live AI assistant. Hosting providers may process standard technical request data under their own terms.

Keep sensitive information out

Do not include passwords, payment details or sensitive customer records in the enquiry. Any future project involving sensitive information needs an agreed handling process.

Contact

For questions about an enquiry, contact neuronest@gmail.com.
